semantics.how: Realpaths the target and checks it is neither the root nor beneath it with a separator suffix
semantics.what: Tells whether a path resolves outside the real root
semantics.why: Stops link chains from pulling outside files into analysis

semantics.how: Walks directories with lstat, skipping dotfiles and SKIP_DIRS, following only contained symlinks, tracking visited real paths, then drops files git ignores
semantics.what: Lists every file under a root, sorted
semantics.when: Called by parseRepoFiles and manifest discovery
semantics.why: The analyzed repo is untrusted input, so links must not escape it and ignored files must not differ from a clone
